instruction: A candid documentary photograph from a side-angle medium full shot shows a ballet studio with wooden floors. The instructor in a black zip-up bodysuit (R1) kneels on the left, holding and guiding the pointed foot of the young girl in a pink leotard (R3). The young girl (R3) stands on the right, holding the barre with her leg extended forward. In the background, another young girl in a pink leotard stands at the barre. The room is illuminated by bright, even indoor lighting.
elements: R1 kneels and holds/guides R3's pointed foot
R3 stands with her leg extended forward while R1 guides her foot
R2 remains a background student at the barre while R1 works with R3
R3 holds the ballet barre for balance
